Synopsis:
SK On (South Korea) signed a 9 GWh LFP battery supply deal with U.S.-based NeoVolta Power for energy storage systems (ESS), running over five years from 2027, produced in Georgia. A second 9 GWh agreement is planned for later this year, bringing potential total cooperation to 18 GWh. The deal reflects a broader Korean battery industry pivot from EV to ESS as U.S. EV subsidies fade. SK On targets 20+ GWh of global ESS orders in the current year with additional U.S. contracts under negotiation.
